# git featuring

Add `git feature`, which publishes the current flow branch under a `feature/` prefix on the remote while keeping the short local name:

```
$ git start xyz-1234 test watcher
$ git feature
# git push -u origin XYZ-1234-test-watcher:feature/XYZ-1234-test-watcher
```

[git_start](../../bin/git_start) creates `XYZ-1234-test-watcher` locally; some teams' tooling (Bitbucket, Jira automation, branch protection) expects `feature/…`, `bugfix/…` names on the server. Pushing with an explicit refspec and `-u` gives both without renaming.
